tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The colour of the <math><msub><mrow><mi>X</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> molecules of group 17 elements changes gradually from yellow to violet down the group. This is due to -

options.text: The physical state of <math><mi> </mi><msub><mrow><mi>X</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  at room temperature changes from gas to solid down the group
Decrease in ionization energy down the group

solution.text:
Halogens are coloured due to HOMO-LUMO transition of electrons.

On moving down the group HOMO-LUMO energy gap decreases so transition of electrons become easier from  Π*2px to σ*2pz therefore colour intensify.
